components.name: site-header
components.behaviors: Contains site name and tagline; static.

components.name: primary-nav
components.behaviors: Horizontal list of links to main sections; indicates current page via aria-current.
components.keyboard_expectations: Tab focus moves through links; Enter activates.

components.name: skip-link
components.behaviors: Initially hidden; becomes visible when focused; jumps to #main-content.
components.keyboard_expectations: Receives focus first; Enter activates link.

components.name: hero-banner
components.behaviors: Prominent call‑to‑action with heading, paragraph, and button.

components.name: service-bands
components.behaviors: Container for service-band components; responsive grid.

components.name: service-band
components.behaviors: Displays service title and toggle button; hides/shows details.
components.keyboard_expectations: Button receives tab focus; Enter/Space toggles panel.

components.name: service-band-toggle
components.behaviors: Toggles aria‑expanded on parent service-band; shows/hides service-details.

components.name: service-details
components.behaviors: Shows service description when parent service-band has aria-expanded="true".

components.name: provider-listing-band
components.behaviors: Contains filter input and provider grid.

components.name: provider-grid
components.behaviors: Grid of doctor-card items; responsive columns.

components.name: doctor-card
components.behaviors: Displays doctor name, specialty, accepting status, location, hospital.

components.name: doctor-filter
components.behaviors: Text input that filters doctor cards by name or specialty; Escape clears.
components.keyboard_expectations: Type to filter; Escape clears input and resets list.

components.name: location-map-band
components.behaviors: Contains static SVG map placeholder, filter dropdown, and location list.

components.name: location-filter
components.behaviors: Dropdown to filter locations by area; change updates list display.
components.keyboard_expectations: Navigate options with ArrowUp/Down; Enter to select.

components.name: location-item
components.behaviors: Shows location/hospital name, address, phone, and associated info.

components.name: site-footer
components.behaviors: Contains copyright text; static.

components.name: breadcrumb
components.behaviors: Not implemented; omitted as source did not show breadcrumbs.

components.name: error-summary
components.behaviors: Displays list of validation errors when form submission fails; role="alert".
components.keyboard_expectations: Receives focus when displayed; screen reader announces.

components.name: appointment-form
components.behaviors: Collects appointment request data; performs client‑side validation; shows simulated success.
components.keyboard_expectations: Tab through fields; Enter on submit button triggers validation.

components.name: insurance-modal-backdrop
components.behaviors: Dark backdrop that covers viewport when modal is open; traps focus.
components.keyboard_expectations: Escape closes modal and returns focus to trigger button.

components.name: insurance-modal
components.behaviors: Dialog containing list of accepted insurance plans; aria‑modal="true".
components.keyboard_expectations: Tab moves focus inside; Escape closes.

components.name: modal-close
components.behaviors: Closes the insurance modal; restores focus to trigger button.

components.name: condition-list
components.behaviors: Container for condition-item elements.

components.name: condition-item
components.behaviors: Shows condition name, typical treatment, related service.

components.name: resource-list
components.behaviors: Container for resource-item elements.

components.name: resource-item
components.behaviors: Shows resource title, link, and category.
